record.paper_title: Constructive Field Theory and Applications: Perspectives and Open Problems
record.original_question: Find an inductive rigorous constructive renormalization scheme that is as simple as Polchinski's inductive perturbative renormalization, even in fermionic settings.

evidence.quote: An open problem which could be mentioned along these lines is to find an inductive rigorous constructive renormalization which would be as simple as Polchinski’s induction for perturbative renormalization [P]: even for Fermions, this remains an open problem

artifact.status_search_result: Recent work (Greenblatt 2024–2025 on the majorant method for the fermionic effective action, and the construction of a weakly-interacting fixed point of the fermionic Polchinski equation, J. Math. Phys. 2024) addresses gaps in the Brydges–Wright fermionic majorant approach and gives rigorous Polchinski-flow constructions for specific models such as Gross–Neveu. However, a general rigorous constructive renormalization scheme that is as simple as Polchinski's perturbative induction, particularly for fermions, has not been established; the question is still regarded as open in the constructive field theory literature.

status_evidence.title: The majorant method for the fermionic effective action (arXiv:2404.06099)
status_evidence.snippet: Brydges and Wright's proof of a majorant method for fermionic systems was later found to have a gap; completing it has remained an open problem.
status_evidence.claim: Closing the gap in the fermionic majorant method—a key step toward a Polchinski-style constructive renormalization for fermions—has remained open and is only recently being addressed.

status_evidence.title: Constructing a weakly-interacting fixed point of the fermionic Polchinski equation (J. Math. Phys. 2024)
status_evidence.snippet: Rigorous existence of a nontrivial fixed point of continuous renormalization group flows for certain weakly interacting fermionic QFTs is proved.
status_evidence.claim: Progress on constructive fermionic Polchinski flows exists for specific models but does not provide a general inductive scheme of Polchinski-level simplicity.

status_evidence.title: Construction of Gross-Neveu model using Polchinski flow (arXiv:2403.18562)
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs the Gross-Neveu model via the Polchinski flow equation.
status_evidence.claim: Polchinski-flow constructive arguments are being developed model by model rather than as a single universal simple induction.
